bills.title: The Municipal Sidewalk & Streetlamp Repair Act
bills.summary: Funds cracked sidewalk repairs along Maple Creek Elementary bus routes and installs bright LED streetlamps downtown.

rider.text: Section 14: Finances all local sidewalk & lamp upgrades via a permanent 3% residential property-tax surcharge on homes built before 1995.

heckles.text: Clean AYE, rookie. Show the Caucus you deliver.
Parents want those lamps, Barnaby—just check who pays for them!

aye.headline: BRIGHT STREETS, STEAMING SENIORS! BARKER PASSES LAMP ACT WITH 3% HOME TAX!
aye.subhead: Parents and downtown shops cheer the new streetlamps while Maple Creek retirees pack town hall over rising tax bills.

nay.headline: BARKER BLOCKS PROPERTY-TAX HIKE—LEAVING SCHOOL CROSSWALKS IN THE DARK!
nay.subhead: Retirees applaud Barker holding the tax line, while Whip Fang and PTA parents frown at the vote board.

abstain.headline: BARKER SITS OUT STREETLAMP VOTE: 'I NEEDED MORE TIME TO PONDER SIDEWALKS'
abstain.subhead: Ducking a tough tax trade-off satisfies nobody back in Maple Creek.

bills.title: The Maple River Free Bridge & Mill Standards Act
bills.summary: Replaces the private toll crossing with a free public bridge and mandates strict new runoff filters for riverside workshops.

heckles.text: Those compliance mandates will crush riverside shops—vote NAY and let donors thank you.
No tricks here—just clean water and a free bridge vs. shop compliance costs!

aye.headline: CLEAN RIVER VICTORY—BUT SMALL MILL SHOPS BRACE FOR COMPLIANCE BILLS!
aye.subhead: Families celebrate the free bridge while riverside merchants worry about costly filter upgrades and K-Street pulls donations.

nay.headline: BARKER SHIELDS RIVERSIDE SHOPS FROM NEW RULES—LEAVING BRIDGE TOLLS IN PLACE!
nay.subhead: Merchants breathe a sigh of relief and donor checks arrive, while Maple Creek parents fume over river runoff.

abstain.headline: BARKER ABSTAINS ON RIVER BRIDGE: 'I HAVE COMPLEX FEELINGS ABOUT TOLLS'
abstain.subhead: Both commuters and shopkeepers leave the gallery scratching their heads.

bills.title: The Regional Rail Depot & Library Roof Act
bills.summary: Repairs the leaking Maple Creek Library roof and constructs a regional commuter-and-freight rail depot bringing 150 local construction jobs.

rider.text: Appropriates $38M in sole-source concrete earmarks for Rep. Troughman's neighboring county and rezones two quiet residential blocks behind Oak Street for freight loading.

heckles.text: MY CONCRETE CONTRACT IS IN THERE—AND YOUR DOWNTOWN SHOPS WANT THAT DEPOT!
Ugly Washington pork... OR 150 jobs for Main Street? Tough call, pup!
Did you read Sal Viper's postcard before judging this one, Barnaby?

aye.headline: DEPOT DEAL PASSES! MAIN STREET CHEERS 150 JOBS AS OAK STREET SENIORS FUME!
aye.subhead: Sal Viper celebrates booming downtown foot traffic while retirees blast the rezoning noise and Troughman's earmark.

nay.headline: BARKER KILLS PORK-STUFFED RAIL DEPOT; MAIN STREET STUNNED OVER LOST JOBS!
nay.subhead: Retirees applaud saving quiet Oak Street, while downtown merchants ask why their own rep killed a major local project.

abstain.headline: BARKER DUCKS RAIL DEPOT VOTE, PLEADS SUDDEN PAPERWORK CRAMP!
abstain.subhead: Neither downtown merchants nor Oak Street retirees appreciate sitting on the fence.

bills.title: The Postal Efficiency & Small-Shop Shipping Act
bills.summary: Cuts bulk shipping fees by 30% for rural storefronts and automates regional parcel sorting hubs.

redactions.hidden: Maple Creek's historic walk-in post office into a regional warehouse 18 miles away

redactions.prefix: Section 6: Replaces Saturday doorstep delivery with
redactions.hidden: commercial drop-boxes leased from K-Street Logistics

heckles.text: Your local bakeries love 30% cheaper parcel rates—don't over-scrub the black ink.
Scrub the redactions, Representative. Know who pays the real price.

aye.headline: POST OFFICE PADLOCKED! SENIORS OUTRAGED AS BARKER BACKS PARCEL CONSOLIDATION!
aye.subhead: Online merchants cheer cheaper bulk rates, while Old Man Boarwell leads a protest outside the shuttered post office.

nay.headline: BARKER SCRUBS REDACTIONS & SAVES MAPLE CREEK POST OFFICE!
nay.subhead: Chairwoman Kodiak offers a rare nod of respect and seniors cheer, though online shops mourn the lost shipping discount.

abstain.headline: BARKER REFUSES TO VOTE ON MAIL BILL: 'THE BLACK INK WAS TOO INTIMIDATING'
abstain.subhead: Chairwoman Kodiak sighs loudly enough to rattle the chandeliers.

bills.title: The 'Main Street Storm Relief & Everything Else' Omnibus
bills.summary: A 1,204-page take-it-or-leave-it bundle assembled overnight. Flip every page before choosing which bruise you can survive!

pages.heading: TITLE I — MAIN STREET STORM RELIEF
pages.body: Provides immediate zero-interest storm-repair loans for downtown bakeries, hardware shops, and family diners.

pages.heading: TITLE II — COUNTY AMBULANCES & SENIOR HEATING
pages.body: Replaces two aging county ambulances and winterizes the Maple Creek Senior Center heating system.

pages.heading: TITLE III (PAGE 1,204) — FISCAL OFFSETS
pages.body: FREEZES PUBLIC ELEMENTARY SCHOOL MAINTENANCE for 4 years, waives private toll-road inspections, and TRIPLES Congressional Luncheon Allowances.

heckles.text: PASS THE OMNIBUS OR LOSE YOUR COMMITTEE STANDING!
Main Street needs those storm loans and Seniors need those ambulances—just sign it!
Either way you vote, I'm waiting in the hallway with a six-second mic!

aye.headline: TRIPLE-LUNCH OMNIBUS! BARKER SAVES SHOPS & AMBULANCES—BY FREEZING SCHOOL REPAIRS!
aye.subhead: Maple Creek parents erupt over Page 1,204 while Whip Fang smiles and Mags Magpie sprints for a live quote.

nay.headline: BARKER TANKS OMNIBUS! CRITICS BLAST 'NO' VOTE ON STORM LOANS & AMBULANCES!
nay.subhead: Parents thank Barker for defending school budgets, while shops and seniors fume—and Mags ambushes him outside.

abstain.headline: OMNIBUS FREEZE: BARKER HIDES BEHIND BINDER DURING MARATHON VOTE!
abstain.subhead: Ducking a giant omnibus leaves every corner of Maple Creek frustrated.

bills.title: Your Signature Legislation
bills.summary: This is why Maple Creek sent you to Washington. Call in banked Favor Tokens or rally Hometown Pressure to reach the vote threshold, then slam CALL THE VOTE!

grassroots.title: The Maple Creek Community Center & Park Act
grassroots.summary: Restores Maple Creek's leaking community hall, upgrades neighborhood playgrounds, and builds an all-weather town pavilion.

climber.title: The Maple Creek Commuter & Downtown Renewal Act
climber.summary: Connects rural stations to county transit hubs and revitalizes small-town storefronts along Highway 9.

pork_baron.title: The Grand Maple Creek Trade Plaza & Jobs Act
pork_baron.summary: Delivers $40M in federal construction contracts (and a suspiciously heroic brass fountain) to downtown Maple Creek.

porkAttachments.label: Keep Your Bill 100% Clean
porkAttachments.description: Zero backroom additions. Maple Creek respects the purity (+4 all blocs), so rely on banked Favors or Hometown Pressure (Avg Blocs >= 65).

porkAttachments.label: Attach Troughman's Expressway Ramp (+1 Vote)
porkAttachments.description: Adds a $22M ramp contract for Rep. Troughman. Guarantees +1 floor vote and boosts construction sentiment, at Seniors' expense.

porkAttachments.label: Slip in Viper's Inspection Waiver (+1 Vote & +14 Funds)
porkAttachments.description: Buried footnote waives municipal developer inspections. Buys a vote and pads your War Chest, angering Families & Seniors.

porkAttachments.label: Let Whip Fang Co-Brand the Bill (+1 Vote & +10 Party)
porkAttachments.description: Leadership puts the Caucus crest on your bill and whips an extra vote—trading some independent appeal at home.

heckles.text: Everyone back in Maple Creek is listening to the chamber radio!
Hope your caucus standing is solid—or your favor pocket is deep.

pass.headline: FRESHMAN TRIUMPH! BARKER'S FLAGSHIP BILL ROARS THROUGH THE HOUSE!
pass.subhead: Maple Creek erupts in applause as the rookie proves he can actually deliver legislation.

fail.headline: DEFEAT ON THE FLOOR! BARKER'S SIGNATURE BILL DIES SHORT OF A MAJORITY!
fail.subhead: Short vote math and bruised pride leave the freshman staring at a silent chamber.

bills.title: The Plain-English Clarity & Paperwork Reduction Act
bills.summary: QUESTION ON THE FLOOR: "Shall the House NOT decline to uphold the repeal of the exemption preventing non-disclosure of committee luxury travel receipts?"

rider.text: PLAIN-ENGLISH TRANSLATION: Four nested negatives! Voting AYE keeps luxury committee junkets SECRET. Voting NAY forces full public receipts!

heckles.text: Go ahead, Barnaby—untangle four negatives while my ad team rolls tape!
It's literally titled 'Clarity'—just stamp AYE!
Diagram the sentence, Representative. Read your staff memo.

aye.headline: DOUBLE-NEGATIVE DISASTER! BARKER VOTES TO HIDE LUXURY TRAVEL RECEIPTS!
aye.subhead: Sterling Foxworth airs a prime-time ad mocking Barker for flunking Capitol grammar.

nay.headline: BARKER CRACKS FOUR-NEGATIVE TRAP; EXPOSES SECRET JUNKET BILL!
nay.subhead: Civics teacher Dr. Oona Owl gives Barker an A+ while insiders scramble to hide resort tabs.

abstain.headline: GRAMMAR PARALYSIS: BARKER ABSTAINS ON 'CLARITY ACT'
abstain.subhead: Foxworth chuckles: 'If he can't read one sentence, how can he represent Maple Creek?'

bills.title: The Campaign Ethics & Donor Transparency Act
bills.summary: Promises sweeping accountability for campaign donations and strict oversight of election-year fundraising.

redactions.hidden: National Committee Bundlers and Anonymous Consulting Shells
a $5,000 federal compliance audit on town potlucks and chamber mixers

heckles.text: Vote against 'Ethics' and watch my billboards go up by noon!
Need ad money to answer Foxworth? This bill fills your War Chest overnight.
A $5,000 audit on local potlucks and chamber mixers?! That's rigged!

aye.headline: POTLUCK CRACKDOWN! BARKER TAXES LOCAL FUNDRAISERS WHILE SHIELDING SHELL FUNDS!
aye.subhead: Barker's War Chest swells to fight Foxworth, but Maple Creek clubs and diners are furious.

nay.headline: BARKER TORCHES FAKE 'ETHICS' BILL; FOXWORTH CRIES FOUL ON CABLE NEWS!
nay.subhead: Maple Creek cheers the rescue of local mixers, though Barker's ad budget takes another hit.

abstain.headline: BARKER ABSTAINS ON ETHICS BILL—FOXWORTH DUBS HIM 'THE VANISHING PUP'
abstain.subhead: Voters wonder why their rep suddenly needed an urgent hallway break.

bills.title: The Highway 9 Flood-Bridge & Committee Order Omnibus
bills.summary: Emergency flood-repair funding for Highway 9 paired with Chairwoman Kodiak's 72-Hour Reading Rule—and a heavily inked Page 3.

pages.heading: TITLE I — EMERGENCY HIGHWAY 9 BRIDGE AID
pages.body: Releases immediate federal grants to reopen three flood-damaged freight and commuter bridges serving Maple Creek.

pages.heading: TITLE II — KODIAK'S 72-HOUR READING RULE
pages.body: Bans surprise 1,000-page midnight drops and guarantees every lawmaker three full days to read bills before voting.

pages.heading: TITLE III — PROCUREMENT ADDENDUM
pages.body: SCRUB THE REDACTION BELOW BEFORE YOU VOTE!

redactions.hidden: 75-year no-bid procurement contracts to Troughman Construction & Viper Consulting with zero audit oversight

heckles.text: Inspect every page, Barker. My endorsement hangs on your backbone.
Delivery trucks are stuck in detours—Main Street wants that bridge open TODAY!
Either way you stamp, my prime-time attack ad is already edited!

aye.headline: NO-BID JACKPOT! BARKER REOPENS HIGHWAY 9—WITH 75-YEAR UN-AUDITED CONTRACTS!
aye.subhead: Local truckers get concrete, K-Street pops champagne, and Chairwoman Kodiak snaps her oak pencil in half.

nay.headline: BARKER EXPOSES NO-BID RIDER; KODIAK PRAISES 'SPINE OF STEEL' AS TRUCKERS FUME!
nay.subhead: Demanding a clean standalone bridge bill wins Kodiak's heavyweight backing—while Main Street groans at ongoing detours.

abstain.headline: BARKER FREEZES ON BRIDGE OMNIBUS; NEITHER COMMUTERS NOR BEARS PLEASED!
abstain.subhead: Mags Magpie pops a fresh flash bulb outside the chamber doors.

bills.title: The Midnight Continuity & Senior Tax Cap Resolution
bills.summary: Final midnight vote on Election Eve! Keeps municipal services open and caps senior property-tax increases for two years.

rider.text: Section 88: Auto-renews 20-year corporate tax loopholes and pays for the senior tax cap by cutting school-bus routes and Main Street micro-grants by 25%.

heckles.text: POLLS OPEN AT SUNRISE! DELIVER THE SENIOR TAX CAP AND STAY WITH THE CAUCUS!
Seniors love the tax cap, Barnaby—but read what Section 88 cuts to pay for it!
HOLD THE PRESSES—THIS FINAL STAMP DECIDES ELECTION DAY!

aye.headline: MIDNIGHT TRADE-OFF! BARKER CAPS SENIOR TAXES BY SLASHING SCHOOL BUSES & SHOP GRANTS!
aye.subhead: Retirees cheer and Barker's War Chest overflows for dawn radio ads, while parents and shops erupt in outrage.

nay.headline: MIDNIGHT STAND! BARKER SAVES SCHOOL BUSES & SHOP GRANTS—RISKING SENIOR BACKLASH!
nay.subhead: Families and Main Street rally at sunrise while Foxworth blasts Barker over the failed senior tax cap.

abstain.headline: LIGHTS OUT: BARKER ABSTAINS AT MIDNIGHT HOURS BEFORE POLLS OPEN!
abstain.subhead: Even the Capitol night-shift custodian looks mildly disappointed.
